name: Large
description: Minor General Virtue that changes a magic character's Size without modifying Strength or Quickness; for Beasts of Virtue it gives -1 Quickness and +2 Strength.

name: Lesser Power
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue granting a limited power designed as a Lesser power; activation costs Fatigue levels based on Might cost. Also a Magic Quality.

name: Magic Animal
description: Special Virtue for a magical animal, such as a Beast of Virtue, designed with Magic Might under the Magical Animal rules.

name: Magic Human
description: Special Virtue for a magical human born with Magic Might and the Monstrous Appearance Inferiority, possibly descended from ancient magical beings.

name: Magic Spirit
description: Special Virtue for a mind, memory, image or idea brought to life by Magic; insubstantial and always having the Magical Air Flaw.

name: Magic Thing
description: Special Virtue for a magical thing of elemental atoms or raw nature; always has Temporary Might and receives No Fatigue free.

name: Magical Blood
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue: exposure to the Magic realm improves the character's true form, giving -1 on Aging rolls, access to Magic Lore and a minor physical advantage; sometimes called faerie blood.

name: Magical Champion
description: Minor Social Status Virtue for magic characters regarded as the particular representative of a small group due to their magical nature.

name: Magical Covenfolk
description: Free Social Status Virtue for a magical being accepted as an equal by the people of its covenant.

name: Magical Master
description: Major Social Status Virtue: the magic character is recognized as a higher power by a large group, which may venerate it.

name: Magical Mount
description: Minor General Virtue granting a mount, beast of burden or guard creature with Cunning and Magic Might up to 25.

name: Magical Warder
description: Major General Virtue: a magical being accompanies and protects the character; generalizes the Ghostly Warder.

name: Ghostly Warder
description: Virtue giving a ghostly protector; cited as a good example of a Magical Warder.

name: Master of (Form) Creatures
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue allowing the character to tame unintelligent beings whose Magic Might is aligned with a particular Form.

name: Personal Power
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue (and Magic Quality) granting a power designed as a Personal power, with Fatigue cost based on Might cost.

name: Ritual Power
description: Major Supernatural Virtue (and Magic Quality) granting a Ritual Power that costs Fatigue and Confidence Points to activate.

name: Transformed (Being)
description: Major Supernatural Virtue: the character is transformed by Magic into a supernatural being with Might 0, gaining Qualities by taking Inferiorities and an Essential Trait.

name: Unaffected by The Gift
description: Minor General Virtue making the character immune to the negative effects of The Gift or Magical Air in others.

name: Variable Power
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue making one magic power grow stronger over time based on age, Might, Warping or an Ability.

name: Voice of the (Land)
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue letting the character speak with any creature native to a particular environment.

name: Essential Virtue
description: Virtue granting a beneficial Essential Trait; every Beast of Virtue must take one to represent how it typifies its species.

name: Gifted
description: Magic Quality/Virtue letting magic characters learn Supernatural Abilities and join Mystery Cults like those with The Gift.

name: Strong Faerie Blood
description: Supernatural Virtue that would become a Greater Power if the character is Transformed by Magic.

name: True Faith
description: Divine Virtue that is lost forever if its possessor is Transformed by Magic.

name: Gift of Tongues
description: Minor Heroic Virtue letting the character understand and speak any language while communicating directly with a fluent speaker; granted by the Wise Owl's Enriched skull.

name: Ferocity
description: Virtue described in Houses of Hermes: Mystery Cults, common among Beasts of Virtue.

name: Berserk
description: Virtue possessed by the Black Boar of the Bog and granted to anyone carrying its Enriched tusks in battle.

name: Puissant Stealth
description: Virtue granted by a cowl made from the Enriched hide of a Black Dog.

name: Puissant Medicine
description: Virtue granted by the Enriched eye paste of a caladrius.

name: Puissant Ride
description: Virtue granted by tack made from the Enriched hooves of the Great Stallion of the Camargue.

name: Puissant Brawl
description: Virtue possessed by Pentele and the Panther of Virtue.

name: Puissant Athletics
description: Virtue possessed by the Stag of Virtue.

name: Keen Vision
description: Virtue granted by the Enriched claws of a Raven of Virtue; incompatible with Weak or Sensitive Sight.

name: Intuition
description: Virtue granted by a ring made from a Raven of Virtue's skull buried under a willow.

name: Wilderness Sense
description: Supernatural Ability/Virtue, common to Beasts of Virtue; granted by the Enriched antlers of the White Stag of the Wood.

name: Second Sight
description: Supernatural Ability/Virtue granted by the Enriched comb of the Cockerel of Virtue.

name: Magic Sensitivity
description: Supernatural Virtue/Ability, an example ability gained via Magical Blood and common among Beasts of Virtue.

name: Premonitions
description: Supernatural Virtue/Ability possessed by the Raven of Virtue.

name: Greater Immunity
description: Virtue common among Beasts of Virtue; the Salamander of Virtue has Greater Immunity to heat and flames.

name: Lesser Immunity
description: Virtue granting immunity to a lesser hazard, e.g. the caladrius to non-lethal diseases or the Stag of Virtue to fevers.

name: Ways of the (Land)
description: Virtue common among Beasts of Virtue, e.g. Ways of the Wood, Moor, Marsh or Forest.

name: Great Characteristic
description: Virtue raising a Characteristic, taken by several Beasts of Virtue.

name: Improved Characteristics
description: Virtue improving Characteristics, taken by several Beasts of Virtue.

name: Self-Confident
description: Virtue possessed by the Black Boar, Black Dog and Pentele.

name: Sharp Ears
description: Virtue possessed by the Black Dog of the Moor and White Stag; incompatible with Weak or Sensitive Hearing.

name: Long-Winded
description: Virtue possessed by the Great Stallion of the Camargue and Stag of Virtue.

name: Strong-Willed
description: Virtue common among Beasts of Virtue.

name: Tough
description: Virtue common among Beasts of Virtue.

name: Reserves of Strength
description: Virtue common among Beasts of Virtue.

name: Puissant Ability
description: Virtue common among Beasts of Virtue.

name: Perfect Balance
description: Virtue possessed by the Panther of Virtue.

name: Sense Holiness and Unholiness
description: Supernatural Ability possessed by the Cockerel of Virtue.

name: Environmental Magic Condition
description: Major Hermetic Flaw halving Casting and Lab Totals in common environmental conditions.

name: Magical Monster
description: Major Social Status Flaw for a magical being with no strong connection to human society; most Beasts of Virtue have it.

name: Servant of the (Land)
description: Major Story Flaw: a powerful magical creature saved the character from death and set a task, enforced by a Prohibition and curse.

name: Wanderlust
description: Major Story Flaw compelling the character to travel, unable to spend more than a season in one place.

name: Age Quickly
description: Major Supernatural Flaw; for magic characters it means rolling for aging once a year, not halted by longevity ritual.

name: Blatant Magical Air
description: Major Supernatural Flaw for those with Magical Air or The Gift, giving -6 to social actions like the Blatant Gift.

name: Bound to Magic
description: Major Supernatural Flaw: the character sickens outside a Magic aura of 5 or greater.

name: Hunger for (Form) Magic
description: Major Supernatural Flaw requiring consumption of 1 pawn of Form vis per season or loss of Long-Term Fatigue.

name: Essential Flaw
description: Major or Minor General Flaw giving a detrimental Essential Trait tied to a Characteristic.

name: Warped Senses
description: Minor Personality Flaw making the character over-sensitive to conditions, e.g. Sensitive (Sense), Weak (Sense), Sensitive to Cold, Sensitive to Heat.

name: Magical Friend
description: Minor Social Status Flaw: the character is considered less than human but favored by a human, e.g. as pet or familiar.

name: Magical (Being) Companion
description: Minor Story Flaw: the character is accompanied by an intelligent magical being it must look after; generalizes Magical Animal Companion.

name: Magical Animal Companion
description: Flaw generalized by Magical (Being) Companion.

name: Baneful Circumstances
description: Minor Supernatural Flaw: in common circumstances the character cannot recover Fatigue, heal, or regain Might.

name: Deteriorating Power
description: Minor Supernatural Flaw reducing one power's effectiveness over time; counterpart to Variable Power.

name: Exiled Atlantean
description: Minor Supernatural Flaw: the character is an Atlantean exiled from her native magic regio, tainted by the surface world.

name: (Form) Monstrosity
description: Minor Supernatural Flaw giving a monstrous feature corresponding to a magical Form; often yields a pawn of Muto vis.

name: Monstrous Blood
description: Minor Supernatural Flaw: exposure to Magic gives the character tainted blood and a minor deformity but resistance to aging.

name: Restricted Power
description: Minor Supernatural Flaw requiring a ceremony or limited targets/circumstances to activate a power.

name: Slow Power
description: Minor Supernatural Flaw requiring an extra round of preparation to activate a power.

name: Anchored to the (Land)
description: Minor General Flaw: -3 to rolls when away from a particular environment, e.g. Anchored to the Sea.

name: Environmental Sensitivity
description: Minor General Flaw: -3 to Stamina debilitation checks when exposed to an uncommon environmental feature.

name: Offensive to (Beings)
description: Minor General Flaw: a Gift-like presence disturbing to animals, spirits or Magic-aligned characters.

name: Poor Concentration
description: Minor General Flaw giving -3 to Concentration rolls.

name: Dwarf
description: Major General Flaw for a mundane human born much smaller than average; magically reduced Size uses Miniature instead.

name: Small Frame
description: Minor General Flaw that changes a magic character's Size without modifying Strength or Quickness.

name: Magical Air
description: Flaw giving a Gift-like disturbing presence; all Magic Spirits have it.

name: Blatant Gift
description: Flaw of an especially disturbing Gift; equivalent to Blatant Magical Air.

name: Deleterious Circumstances
description: Hermetic Flaw; Environmental Magic Condition is significantly more restrictive.

name: Prohibition
description: Minor Personality Flaw imposed by Servant of the (Land); failing the task brings a curse.

name: Favors
description: Major Story Flaw required when a Magical Mount was a gift from a patron.

name: Greater Malediction
description: Flaw common among Beasts of Virtue.

name: Lesser Malediction
description: Flaw common among Beasts of Virtue.

name: Nocturnal
description: Flaw possessed by the Black Boar, Black Dog and Wise Owl.

name: Overconfident
description: Flaw possessed by the Cockerel of Virtue and Great Stallion.

name: Higher Purpose
description: Flaw possessed by the Great Stallion, Stag of Virtue and White Stag (protect the herd/wood).

name: Compulsion
description: Flaw, e.g. the Cockerel's compulsion to fight for dominance and the Raven's to steal shiny objects.

name: Hatred
description: Flaw, e.g. the Panther's hatred of beasts and the Stag of Virtue's hatred of serpents.

name: Proud
description: Personality Flaw possessed by the Black Dog and Pentele.

name: Noncombatant
description: Flaw possessed by the caladrius and Salamander of Virtue.

name: Weak Characteristics
description: Flaw possessed by the Raven and Salamander of Virtue.

name: Depressed
description: Personality Flaw temporarily gained by a cockerel that loses a dominance fight.

name: Fury
description: Flaw possessed by the Black Boar and Black Dog.

name: Wrathful
description: Flaw possessed by the Black Boar of the Bog.

name: Greater Power
description: Magic Quality granting a major innate power; the most common power type among Beasts of Virtue.

name: Monstrous Appearance
description: Magic Inferiority always possessed by Magic Humans.

name: Temporary Might
description: Magic Inferiority always possessed by Magic Things: spent Might recovers slowly and injury separates Might as vis.

name: No Fatigue
description: Magic Quality received free by Magic Things.

name: Miniature
description: Magic Inferiority used for a character of magically reduced Size.

name: Gigantic
description: Magic Quality possessed by the Black Boar and Black Dog.

name: Susceptible to Deprivation
description: Magic Inferiority possessed by nearly all example Beasts of Virtue.

name: Improved Might
description: Magic Quality increasing Might, taken by several Beasts of Virtue.

name: Improved Powers
description: Magic Quality reducing Might cost of powers.

name: Gift of Speech
description: Magic Quality possessed by the Wise Owl of the Forest.

name: Vis Mastery
description: Magic Quality possessed by the White Stag of the Wood.

name: Magic Quality
description: Beneficial trait of magic characters bought with Might; can be gained by Transformation.

name: Magic Inferiority
description: Detrimental trait of magic characters that grants extra Magic Qualities.

name: Magic Might
description: Might Score aligned with the Magic realm possessed by magic characters; subtracted from Advancement Totals.

name: Magic Character Creation
description: Rules in Realms of Power: Magic for designing magic animals, humans, spirits and things.

name: Animal Handling
description: General Ability to train and care for animals, extendable to other beings with Cunning such as elementals and animate trees.

name: Animal Ken
description: Supernatural Ability allowing communication with any animal, magical or not.

name: (Form) Resistance
description: Supernatural Ability for characters with Magic Might, adding to Soak and Magic Resistance against a Form; e.g. Vim, Ignem, Animal, Terram Resistance.

name: Magical Meditation
description: Supernatural Ability for Magic Might characters: a trance to recover Might Points and resist Acclimation in a Magic aura.

name: Magic Lore
description: Ability used like Folk Ken to understand magical beings; available to characters with Magical Blood.

name: Folk Ken
description: Ability for understanding human beings, possibly human-like beings.

name: Faerie Lore
description: Ability possessed by the Wise Owl of the Forest.

name: Bargain
description: Social Ability usable with any intelligent being.

name: Carouse
description: Social Ability usable with any intelligent being.

name: Charm
description: Social Ability usable with any intelligent being.

name: Etiquette
description: Social Ability usable with any intelligent being.

name: Guile
description: Social Ability usable with any intelligent being.

name: Intrigue
description: Social Ability usable with any intelligent being.

name: Leadership
description: Social Ability usable with any intelligent being.

name: Teaching
description: Social Ability usable with any intelligent being.

name: Concentration
description: Ability; Magical Meditation replaces it on the Concentration table.

name: Penetration
description: Ability adding to a power's ability to overcome Magic Resistance.

name: Entrancement
description: Supernatural Ability; infernal Entrancement becomes tainted magic on Transformation, and a Panther's tongue can grant it.

name: Hunt
description: Ability possessed by several Beasts of Virtue.

name: Stealth
description: Ability used by Beasts of Virtue.

name: Survival
description: Ability used by Beasts of Virtue.

name: Brawl
description: Ability used by Beasts of Virtue for natural weapons.

name: Athletics
description: Ability used by Beasts of Virtue.

name: Awareness
description: Ability used by Beasts of Virtue.

name: (Area) Lore
description: Ability of knowledge of an area, e.g. the Great Stallion's Camargue Lore.

name: Acclimation
description: Process by which magic characters lose Magic Qualities or Might yearly unless sustained by a Magic aura, magical effects, or vis.

name: Transformation
description: Process of permanently improving a magic character's form by gaining Qualities via experience or vis, without changing its essential nature.

name: Essential Traits
description: Unchanging Personality/Character Traits of Magic Might characters; magic forcing action against them fails.

name: Vis Consumption
description: Chart rolled when a magic character avoids Acclimation by consuming vis, with botch, side effect, story event or transformation results.

name: Vis
description: Raw magic in pawns; consumed by magic characters to advance and avoid Acclimation, found in the bodies of Beasts of Virtue.

name: Dedicated Vis
description: Vis tied to an Art combination, e.g. Perdo Ignem in the Salamander of Virtue.

name: Spell-Like Vis
description: Vis with an effect resembling a spell, e.g. the Stag of Virtue's right antler.

name: The Gift
description: Supernatural gift whose negative social effects disturb others; Magic Spirits have a similar Magical Air.

name: Magic Aura
description: Area aligned with Magic; magic characters living in strong enough auras avoid Acclimation.

name: Twilight Scars
description: Marks gained by magi from Twilight, basically Essential Traits for magi.

name: Familiar
description: Magical creature bound to a Hermetic magus; the bond protects it from Acclimation and Beasts of Virtue suit it well.

name: Longevity Ritual
description: Hermetic ritual halting aging; cannot halt magical Age Quickly.

name: Warping
description: Supernatural distortion; animals Warped by Magic may gain Flaws like Bound to Magic.

name: Mystery Cult
description: Cult through which Gifted magic characters may initiate new Virtues and Flaws.

name: Initiation Script
description: Script for initiating Virtues; a book on Magic Qualities might resemble one.

name: Mystagogue
description: Mystery Cult initiator who may adapt a book of Magic Qualities for Initiation.

name: Object of Virtue
description: Item made by a hedge magician from the vis-bearing body part of a Beast of Virtue.

name: Enriched
description: Process of preparing a Beast of Virtue's vis-bearing part so it grants a Virtue or power.

name: Necessary Condition
description: Requirement for using an Enriched Thing of Virtue, e.g. placing the Panther tongue in the mouth.

name: Law of Sympathy
description: Magical principle by which the Cockerel of Virtue's cry terrifies spirits of darkness.

name: Law of Contagion
description: Magical principle transferring the Stag of Virtue's fever immunity to those who eat its flesh.

name: Regio
description: Magical region; Atlanteans are native to a magic regio.

name: Confidence Points
description: Points spent to activate Ritual Powers or suppress Monstrous Blood effects.

name: Mastery Points
description: Points traded from Virtue levels to reduce a power's Might cost.

name: Magic Resistance
description: Resistance to magic; (Form) Resistance adds to it for magic characters.

name: Parma Magica
description: Hermetic magic resistance; (Form) Resistance does not stack with it.

name: Herbs of Virtue
description: Magical herbs such as the mandrake, described in Chapter 8: Magic Things.

name: Magic Realm
description: The realm of Magic; magic characters can retreat there to avoid Acclimation, treated as an aura of 10 for visitors.

name: Faerie Realm
description: Supernatural realm often confused with Magic by people of Mythic Europe; faerie powers become magic ones on Transformation.

name: Infernal Realm
description: Realm of evil; infernal powers become tainted magic on Transformation, and Black Dogs are wrongly thought its agents.

name: Divine Realm
description: Realm whose powers are lost when a character is Transformed by Magic.

name: Twilight Void
description: Part of the Magic Realm where the most powerful magic characters never suffer Acclimation.

name: Mythic Europe
description: The setting world of Ars Magica.

name: Camargue
description: Large, flat, marshy delta region of the Rhône River, home of magical wild horses.

name: Rhône River
description: River whose delta forms the Camargue.

name: Normandy Tribunal
description: Tribunal whose inhabitants find comfortable the temperate climate on the Environmental Temperatures chart.

name: Rhine Tribunal
description: Tribunal cited as the comfortable temperature norm.

name: Stonehenge Tribunal
description: Tribunal cited as the comfortable temperature norm.

name: Hibernia Tribunal
description: Tribunal cited as the comfortable temperature norm.

name: Peloponnesus
description: Region ravens flew from, per Pliny, after the massacre of Median mercenaries.

name: Attica
description: Region ravens flew from, per Pliny.

name: Media
description: Land whose mercenary soldiers were massacred, per Pliny.

name: Africa
description: Source of panthers brought to Italy for the Roman circus.

name: Italy
description: Destination of African panthers for the Roman circus.

name: Pierre de Beauvais
description: Medieval bestiary author quoted on the caladrius, lion, salamander and stag.

name: Pliny the Elder
description: Roman author of Naturalis Historia, quoted on panthers and ravens.

name: Pentele
description: A Lion of Virtue, literally the King of Beasts, ruling a remote animal kingdom with a retinue of Beasts of Virtue.

name: Beast of Virtue
description: A perfect magical example of its species, rare and well suited as a familiar; corpse contains vis.

name: Transformed Beast
description: Magical beast with powers beyond its species' perfection, often from failed Hermetic attempts to create Beasts of Virtue.

name: Black Boar of the Bog
description: Beast of Virtue, a huge black boar with Magic Might 20 guarding a swampy wood; powers Protect the Herd and Terror of the Charging Boar.

name: Black Dog of the Moor
description: Beast of Virtue, a gigantic black hound with Magic Might 25 that prowls a moor at night.

name: Black Dogs
description: Class of solitary black hounds known throughout northern Europe under many names, wrongly thought Infernal.

name: Caladrius
description: Magnificent white heron-like Beast of Virtue that heals disease by gazing into a patient's eyes and flying toward the sun.

name: Cockerel of Virtue
description: Beast of Virtue whose crowing drives away nocturnal spirits; the only beast that cows Pentele.

name: Great Stallion of the Camargue
description: White stallion Beast of Virtue leading the magical wild horses of the Camargue.

name: Horses of Virtue
description: Herd of magical horses (Might 10) of the Camargue led by the Great Stallion.

name: Lion of Virtue
description: Beast of Virtue king of beasts, merciful, fearful of turning wheels and enemy of dragons.

name: Panther of Virtue
description: Hideous-faced spotted Beast of Virtue whose fragrant breath lures prey.

name: Raven of Virtue
description: Bird of ill omen that foresees calamities and warns humans to cause anxiety.

name: Salamander of Virtue
description: Tiny Ignem-aligned lizard Beast of Virtue that extinguishes fires and poisons water and plants.

name: Stag of Virtue
description: Beast of Virtue, enemy of serpents, rejuvenating by eating venomous snakes; its right antler heals.

name: White Stag of the Wood
description: Powerful magical white elk, Magical Master ruling a forest and protecting its herd.

name: Wise Owl of the Forest
description: Talking grey owl Beast of Virtue, curious and starved for conversation.

name: Dog of Virtue
description: Example Beast of Virtue that may have enhanced tracking but not fire breath.

name: Viper of Virtue
description: Example Beast of Virtue that might have Deception as Essential Virtue.

name: Dragon
description: Mighty magic animals; natural enemies of Lions of Virtue and immune to panther breath.

name: Scitalis
description: Dragon-kind creature suggested as an Ignem or Imaginem familiar.

name: Hercinia
description: Creature suggested as an Ignem familiar.

name: Hoopoe
description: Bird suggested as a Vim familiar.

name: Mandrake
description: Herb of Virtue suggested as a Corpus or Herbam familiar.

name: Atlantean
description: Beings native to a magic regio; exiles are tainted by the surface world.

name: Elementals
description: Beings with Cunning that Animal Handling may train.

name: Protect the Herd
description: Black Boar power giving it and animal allies +5 Soak for Sun duration.

name: Terror of the Charging Boar
description: Black Boar power filling anyone it charges with mortal fear.

name: Nose of the Bloodhound
description: Black Dog power to track a scented quarry anywhere.

name: Dominate Canine
description: Black Dog power making canines obey its voice.

name: Leader of the Pack
description: Black Dog power making canines fight as a trained group at +2.

name: Shadow Form
description: Black Dog power to become shadow, +4 Stealth and immune to physical attacks.

name: Aura of Rightful Authority
description: Spell similar to the Black Dog's Dominate Canine.

name: Healing Gaze
description: Caladrius Ritual Power drawing non-fatal disease from a patient into itself.

name: Perceive the Afflictions of Mortal Flesh
description: Caladrius power identifying diseases by sight.

name: Scourge the Spirits of the Night
description: Cockerel of Virtue's crow causing nocturnal spirits to flee.

name: Sense the Feet that Tread the Earth
description: Great Stallion power sensing movement on the ground within a mile.

name: Sprint of the Zephyr
description: Great Stallion power to gallop a league in one Diameter.

name: The Unimpeded Traveler
description: Great Stallion power ignoring terrain, even crossing water and chasms.

name: Great Leap
description: Power to leap 30 paces up or 50 across, possessed by the Great Stallion and White Stag.

name: Terrifying Roar
description: Lion of Virtue roar freezing hearers in terror.

name: Trackless Step
description: Power to leave no tracks, used by the Lion of Virtue and White Stag.

name: Circle of Beast Warding
description: Lion of Virtue power tracing a circle no mundane beast can cross.

name: Sleep with Eyes Open
description: Lion of Virtue power preventing surprise while sleeping.

name: Mastering the Unruly Beast
description: ArM5 spell duplicated by a collar from a Lion of Virtue's Enriched mane.

name: Pleasing Breath
description: Panther of Virtue power whose fragrant breath entrances humans and beasts.

name: Devouring the Heat of the Fire
description: Salamander power extinguishing any fire it touches.

name: Sense of the Bright Flame
description: Salamander power locating fires as if by hearing.

name: Poisoning the Well
description: Salamander power poisoning water by touch.

name: Poisoning the Fruit of the Vine
description: Salamander power making plants poisonous.

name: Poisonous Skin
description: Salamander's constant contact poison.

name: Healing
description: Stag of Virtue power healing its own wounds after eating dittany.

name: Delay the Serpent's Venom
description: Stag of Virtue power delaying poison until sunrise or sunset.

name: Alleviate the Serpent's Bite
description: Stag of Virtue power neutralizing poison after drinking water.

name: Restoration of the Defiled Body
description: ArM5 spell whose effect the Stag's right-antler vis resembles.

name: Defense of the Herd
description: White Stag power giving deer +2 defense as a trained group.

name: Confuse Predator
description: White Stag power confusing enemies.

name: Confusion of the Numbed Will
description: ArM5 spell similar to Confuse Predator.

name: Shriek of the Impending Shafts
description: Spell, also a White Stag power, warning against wooden weapons.

name: Immobilize Prey
description: Wise Owl power paralyzing any creature meeting its eyes.

name: Greater Purifying Touch
description: Effect granted by the cup from the Stag's Enriched antler, neutralizing poison.

name: Black Boar Tusks
description: Enriched tusks of the Black Boar that grant Berserk to their bearer in battle.

name: Black Dog Hide Cowl
description: Cowl from a Black Dog's Enriched hide granting Puissant Stealth.

name: Lion Mane Collar
description: Collar woven from a Lion of Virtue's mane that duplicates Mastering the Unruly Beast.

name: Stag Antler Cup
description: Cup carved from a Stag of Virtue's right antler that neutralizes poison.

name: Creo
description: Hermetic Art; listed with suggested familiar animals and associated monstrosities.

name: Intellego
description: Hermetic Art; listed with suggested familiar animals and associated monstrosities.

name: Muto
description: Hermetic Art; listed with suggested familiar animals and associated monstrosities.

name: Perdo
description: Hermetic Art; listed with suggested familiar animals and associated monstrosities.

name: Rego
description: Hermetic Art; listed with suggested familiar animals and associated monstrosities.

name: Animal
description: Hermetic Art; listed with suggested familiar animals and associated monstrosities.

name: Aquam
description: Hermetic Art; listed with suggested familiar animals and associated monstrosities.

name: Auram
description: Hermetic Art; listed with suggested familiar animals and associated monstrosities.

name: Corpus
description: Hermetic Art; listed with suggested familiar animals and associated monstrosities.

name: Herbam
description: Hermetic Art; listed with suggested familiar animals and associated monstrosities.

name: Ignem
description: Hermetic Art; listed with suggested familiar animals and associated monstrosities.

name: Imaginem
description: Hermetic Art; listed with suggested familiar animals and associated monstrosities.

name: Mentem
description: Hermetic Art; listed with suggested familiar animals and associated monstrosities.

name: Terram
description: Hermetic Art; listed with suggested familiar animals and associated monstrosities.

name: Vim
description: Hermetic Art; listed with suggested familiar animals and associated monstrosities.

name: Magic Character
description: Character with a Magic Might Score; advances only with difficulty via Transformation and must avoid Acclimation.

name: Hedge Magician
description: Non-Hermetic practitioner who can make a Beast of Virtue's vis-bearing part into an Object of Virtue.
